description: LiveDataLink is an MCP server giving AI agents instant access to 243 real-time data tools across 53 domains: finance, crypto, FMCSA trucking safety, sanctions screening, federal courts, cybersecurity feeds, FEMA disasters, weather, vehicles, property records, education, geocoding, federal grants, CPSC product-safety, and more. One server, one API key, pay per query, free tier available.
